title: File-based agent project management
titleZh: 基于文件的 Agent 项目管理
summary: File boundaries and reading paths help agents find current work, applicable rules, and the sources behind a result.
summaryZh: 用文件归属与读取路径定位当前任务、适用规则和结果来源，减少接手时的上下文歧义。
ownership: I directed and reviewed the changes to my project workflows; Codex implemented the files and helped check them.
ownershipZh: 我提出并审查工作流的修改，Codex 完成文件实现并协助核对。

title: AIQuant
summary: A personal research system connecting a remote Parquet lake, Codex research tools, and strategy replay. No candidate currently meets promotion requirements.
summaryZh: 连接远端 Parquet 数据湖、Codex 研究工具和策略回放的个人研究系统。目前没有达到晋级要求的候选。
ownership: I set the research requirements, choose the next investigation, and review the results. Codex helps implement the tools, research sources, and diagnose problems. This is research; live trading and order APIs remain disabled.
ownershipZh: 我提出研究要求、选择下一步并审查结果，Codex 协助实现工具、查资料和排障。项目处于研究阶段，实盘和订单接口未启用。
details: The system lets me test market hypotheses against repeatable data and explicit execution assumptions. An early A-share news-and-momentum sample remains separate from the later contract research workflow.

Recent CSV features pass through a version-aware sync queue into UTC instrument-hour Parquet/ZSTD parts. Compute reads the shared remote store; incremental catalogs locate inputs without copying the archive into agent context.
Codex works from compact reading packs and registered research tools. Reusable Skills cover the procedures, while Python performs transformations, backtests, and report generation.

A next-month order-flow diagnostic produced 319 reference trades but remained near break-even at zero assumed cost and negative with costs. It is reused OOS with unverified fills, not formal performance. The current decision still has no promotion-ready candidate.
detailsZh: 系统用于把行情假设放进可重复的数据与明确执行条件里检查。早期 A 股新闻与动量样例仍保留，和后来的合约研究工作流分开介绍。
近期 CSV 特征经版本化同步队列进入按 UTC 品种小时划分的 Parquet/ZSTD 分片。计算读取同一份远端存储，增量 catalog 帮助定位输入，无需把完整行情塞进 Agent 上下文。
Codex 读取轻量研究包并调用已注册工具，Skills 保存可复用操作要求，Python 负责转换、回测和生成报告。
一项订单流次月诊断得到 319 笔参考交易，零成本接近盈亏平衡，计入成本后为负；它属于 reused OOS，成交未验证，不是正式表现。当前仍无可晋级候选。

title: BioFlow: omics collection and standardization
titleZh: BioFlow：组学数据采集与标准化
summary: A five-stage pipeline connecting papers, accessions, dataset files, and sample metadata. Language models assist with selected judgments; Python tools perform the data processing.
summaryZh: 把论文、数据编号、数据文件和样本元数据接起来的五阶段流程。语言模型参与部分判断，Python 工具执行数据处理。
ownership: A project I worked on at Guangzhou National Laboratory. I shaped the workflow and later requested isolated omics extensions and Skill-based stage organization; Codex assisted with implementation and debugging. AnnData, Scanpy, and other libraries supply their own components.
ownershipZh: 我在广州国家实验室参与的项目，围绕受约束流程设计，后续提出隔离扩展组学与按 Skill 拆分阶段的要求，Codex 协助实现和排障。AnnData、Scanpy 等库提供各自组件。
details: The project began with a need to collect public omics data for virtual-cell modeling. Each stage leaves inspectable outputs so a format fix can reuse earlier literature and downloads.

Regex-first accession extraction, a directory probe and registered-loader planner, and missing-value metadata enrichment address different kinds of uncertainty. They do not establish data relevance or scientific validity by themselves.

RNA, ATAC, and spatial data have matrix-building paths. Protein, metabolomics, and imaging currently use collection bundles with separate output roots; their quantitative or image-analysis processing is not implemented here.

The later Sentinel prototype implements SQLite task state, workers, retries, and heartbeats. Eight existing unit tests passed in this review, while a historical tiny_e2e run stopped at stage two. Production adoption and complete real-data execution remain unverified.
detailsZh: 项目起于为虚拟细胞模型收集公开组学数据的需求。各阶段留下可检查的产物，修格式适配时可以沿用已经完成的文献与下载材料。
正则优先的编号提取、目录探测与已注册 loader 选择、缺失元数据补充，分别处理不同的不确定性；这些步骤本身不能证明数据相关性或科学有效性。
RNA、ATAC、空间数据有各自的矩阵构建路径。蛋白、代谢和影像目前采用目录隔离的 collection bundle，这里没有完成它们的定量处理或图像分析。
后来的 Sentinel 原型实现 SQLite 任务状态、worker、重试和心跳。本次复查通过现有 8 项单元测试，历史 tiny_e2e 小样则停在第二阶段；生产采用与完整真实数据链路仍未验收。

title: Image Reconstruction Through Multiple 1D Approximations
titleZh: 多重一维近似图像重建
summary: My master’s thesis explores image reconstruction through multiple one-dimensional projections, interpolation, and sample selection under a fixed representation budget.
summaryZh: 硕士论文研究在固定表示预算下，怎样通过多个一维投影、插值与采样选择重建图像。
ownership: I conducted the thesis research and comparisons. Sampling choices that failed are part of the story, alongside the successful settings.
ownershipZh: 我完成论文研究与比较。失败的采样方案和有效的设置一样，都是这项工作的组成部分。

title: SCage / TempoFactor
summary: Modeling sample time and cell state, then asking what survives held-out evaluation and downstream analysis. Local spatial ordering remains a limited observation.
summaryZh: 建模样本时间与细胞状态，再检查哪些结论能经受留出评估和下游分析。局部空间排序仍是有限观察。
ownership: I contribute to model refactoring, benchmarks, attribution and validation. Spatial predictions do not establish lineage, absolute speed, or mechanism.
ownershipZh: 我参与模型重构、benchmark、归因和验证。空间预测不能证明谱系、绝对发育速度或机制。

title: Neural Fields for Spatial Transcriptomics
titleZh: 空间转录组的 Neural Field 探索
summary: Coordinate-based expression modeling exposed a useful failure: fitting observed points well did not guarantee interpolation across sparsely observed slices.
summaryZh: 基于坐标的表达建模留下了一个有用的失败：已观测点拟合得好，并不保证跨稀疏切片的插值可靠。
ownership: I reimplemented a coordinate-to-latent pipeline and compared models. SUICA, STINR and other reference methods belong to their original authors.
ownershipZh: 我重实现了坐标到 latent 的流程并比较模型。SUICA、STINR 等参考方法属于原作者。

title: Bona: YOLO training and visual control
summary: YOLO-family training for household-object detection, plus a separate real-time visual-control prototype from the same internship. Server-side training was not robot deployment.
summaryZh: 同一段实习中的家居物体 YOLO 系列训练与另一个实时视觉控制原型。服务器训练不等于机器人端部署。
ownership: My work included model and training experiments. The detection task and the visual-control prototype are separate technical strands.
ownershipZh: 我的工作包含模型与训练实验。检测任务和视觉控制原型是两条分别核验的技术线。

title: Bus Equity
summary: A team analysis of transit equity in Greater Boston. My documented responsibility was regional differences, with participation across the wider analysis.
summaryZh: 团队分析大波士顿地区的公交公平性。我在文档中主责地区差异分析，并参与更广的分析流程。
ownership: I owned the regional-analysis question and presented another question for the team. The complete analysis was a team result.
ownershipZh: 我主责地区分析问题，并为团队代讲另一个问题。整体分析属于团队成果。

title: Data Days for Good
summary: A team R Shiny product built from survey data and free text. My reported focus was cleaning comments, sentiment groups, and frequent words.
summaryZh: 基于问卷和自由文本的团队 R Shiny 产品。我确认的个人重点是评论清洗、情绪分组与高频词。
ownership: I contributed text analysis; the application was delivered by the team. The exact classifier and my share of reactive code remain unverified.
ownershipZh: 我参与文本分析，应用由团队共同交付。具体分类器和 reactive 代码分工尚未核实。
